newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian shares rise slightly in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian shares rise slightly in brisk trade.

text.p: Nigerian shares made small gains in active Monday trade with insurance company shares showing a burst of activity, traders said.
By 1830 (1730 GMT) the all-share index had not been updated.
Interest in the insurance sector followed a series of recent good results.
AIICO Insurance climbed five kobo to 5.35 naira, UNIC rose two kobo to 3.10 naira while Law Union and Rock finished seven kobo higher at 5.25 naira.
West African Portland Cement gained 10 kobo to close at 27.80 naira.
Similar 10 kobo gains were made by conglomerate Lever Brothers at 24.02 naira, Cadbury at 23.10 naira and Unipetrol at 33.50 naira.
Packaging shares were headed downwards. CMB slid by five kobo to 4.55 naira and Studio Press was down two kobo to 1.35 naira.
Conglomerate CFAO dropped four kobo to 5.92 naira. Aviation Development Company fell two to close at 5.44 naira.
Printing and publishing firm Academy Press went ex-dividend at 1.77 naira, down 15 kobo.
